QuestInfo.name: Lost Moonlight Sonata
QuestInfo.1: Gold Richie says that he bought the sheet music, but lost it when monsters attacked him on the way to his safe. He cannot remember what kind of monster attacked him...  Maybe you have to start hunting random monsters?
QuestInfo.2: Gold Richie told you that he lost the sheet music on the way to his safe when he was attacked by monsters. Luckily you were able to retrieve the sheet music. You wanted to take the sheet music directly to Grandpa Moon Bunny, but since it was sealed so tightly you were afraid of ripping the sheet music by opening the seal. You had to take the sheet music back to Gold Richie.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 500\n\nCan proceed to the 'Music Box Parts' quest

0.0: So, is it the sheet music you're looking for?\r\n#L0##bGrandpa Moon Bunny sent me here. Can you show me the sheet music?#l\n#k
0.1: Hmm... I don't think I can. It's not that I don't want to show it to you. I have my own reasons... Phew... To tell you the truth, I recently got my hands on the #bMoonlight Sonata Sheet Music#k. But then, while I was on my way to store it in my safe, I was attacked by monsters and the sheet music was stolen.  If you can recover it from the monsters, I'll let you look it over.

yes.0: I don't know anything about the monsters that attacked me. The sheet music could be on any of them.

no.0: You must give to receive... That's the foundation of trade.

1.0: I can't believe it! You found the sheet music!

default.0: I don't know anything about the monsters that attacked me. The sheet music could be on any of them. But I'm sure that the monsters have the #bMoonlight Sonata Sheet Music#k.
